scope: No live actions; pure helper and exact candidate Agent.route source execution on captured fixtures.

local_cohesion.reason: RID identity, freshness or membership unverified

visible_external_bssid_mapping.cohesion_reason: no strict majority for candidate LAN

actual_limit: M02 RID host timestamps are ~14199.96s old despite recent=true; strict freshness correctly disables mutual majority. S07 RID age ~11.45s passes. Do not claim majority active on live M02 from this fixture.
composition_limit: Two contemporaneous SSH observations are composed as prospective authenticated peer payloads to test route inheritance. This does not assert those records were exchanged by the running service.
mapping_limit: Visible external BSSIDs are mapped only to independently observed group direct LANs. Credential eligibility and activation probes are not evaluated by this mapping diagnostic.

contract.group: All RID map entries complete, recent, UID-bound, non-conflicting, key/node matched and host-fresh; node_count/list consistent; peers mutually contain full-UID-derived short IDs.
contract.majority: At least two distinct UID voters, strictly more than half of local complete group membership; stale/partial evidence makes group unknown, not a smaller denominator.
contract.lan: Canonical IPv4 CIDR + gateway IP + gateway unicast MAC hash; inherited only through fresh valid authenticated parent/path.
contract.unknown: Equal SSID or numeric RS485 ID never establishes identity or BSSID-to-LAN mapping.
contract.decision: Healthy known-LAN tie stays; viable direct majority can override marginal cost only after dwell/confirmations. Known same-root direct recovery bypasses relay band lock; weak/failure fallback preserved.
contract.fallback: Missing metadata retains the independently tested narrow direct-uplink protection.
